verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a Document Segmentation capability that splits multi-document PDFs into separate logical sections, plus a segment endpoint that identifies segments from a schema and returns page ranges for each one. Saved checkpoints feed /extract and /segment from a single parse, and pipelines can chain convert, extract and segment, so one upload plausibly yields per-document outputs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the pipeline runs extraction per segment and returns separate per-document results (segmentation itself returns only page ranges), detail on how document types are classified beyond the user-supplied schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
